title: [SEED] CHAPEL PERILOUS
subtitle: [SEED] a recovered operations manual
boot: [SEED] The map is not the territory. Neither, it turns out, is the territory.
prompt_enter_site: [SEED] A door where the map insists there is none. Enter?
prompt_exit_site: [SEED] Arrows crawl; Esc returns you to the surface, if it is still there.
npc_greetings: [SEED] nods as if you had an appointment, and walks on.
[SEED] asks the time, then answers it themselves. Wrongly.
[SEED] presses a leaflet into your hand. It is blank on both sides.
[SEED] mistakes you for someone else, and is relieved to be wrong.
[SEED] mutters a number under their breath and keeps walking.
[SEED] tips a hat that isn't there and is gone before you answer.
beast_note: [SEED] blocks the road — no words for this one.
rest_refused_wild: [SEED] the open country offers no bed; rest waits for walls.
[SEED] you cannot make camp here — the ground is still watching.
[SEED] rest is a service of the town, not the field.

onterrain.DEEP: [SEED] Deep water. It does not want you.
onterrain.SAND: [SEED] Sand. Someone raked a 23 into it and left.
onterrain.GRASS: [SEED] Grass. Ordinary, which is the suspicious part.
onterrain.HILL: [SEED] High ground. The pattern is easier to see from here, or worse.

DEEP: [SEED] The deep water declines your application to cross it.
[SEED] You step toward the dark water; the dark water steps back. Net zero.
[SEED] Below the surface, something keeps very still. You keep to the shore.
WATER: [SEED] The shallows soak your boots and refuse the rest of you.
[SEED] Reed and standing water. Not a road, whatever the map alleges.
[SEED] Your foot finds mud where it wanted ground. You reconsider.
MOUNT: [SEED] Stone the size of an argument. You lose the argument.
[SEED] The ridge is not interested in a shortcut today.
default: [SEED] Something declines to let you pass here.
[SEED] The way is shut, in the ordinary, unremarkable manner of shut ways.
[SEED] You bump the edge of the possible and step back onto it.
